status: Closed — quoted validator command identity verified 2026-09-05
finding: Evidence validator linking splits literal task-card validator commands on commas even when the comma appears inside a quoted command argument, causing taskflow pre-close to report stale evidence for a command that already passed.
expectedBehavior: Evidence run/add and taskflow pre-close should preserve a task-declared literal validator command as one validator identity, including quoted arguments that contain commas.
evidenceOrRepro: The historical TASK-RFT-0096 failure is repaired by `d69187291` (`fix(evidence): normalize quoted validator commands`). Current `packages/cli/src/commands/evidence/validator-classification.ts` canonicalizes shell-quoted command tokens before validator matching, and `packages/cli/src/commands/evidence/missing-report.ts` compares command runs through that canonical identity. Current focused evidence tests `validator-classification.spec.ts`, `run.spec.ts`, and `command-runs.spec.ts` all pass; `npm run validate:cli` also passes its 42-command fast profile. The original split-command stale-evidence path is therefore no longer reproducible on current main.
followUp: Keep literal validator commands represented as command-run records and preserve canonical command identity when adding new evidence transports. Reopen only if a quoted-argument regression reproduces under the current canonicalization seam.
